name: David Attenborough (BLOCKED - real person)
sounds_like: Mid male at 133 Hz with a wide 13.5-semitone range, rising and falling across each phrase. Unhurried at 4.5 onsets per second but almost gapless - only 5% silence and a longest pause of 0.10s - so it flows continuously. Mid timbre (centroid 1484 Hz), Received Pronunciation. The source is a 2012 Desert Island Discs clip describing being touched by a mountain gorilla.
avoid_for: All casting, and especially the wildlife-documentary narration it would obviously be reached for. Use male_04_frank for measured documentary voiceover instead.
note: BLOCKED - this is a voice clone of a real, identifiable person. This project craft notes say these must not be cast, and that holds regardless of the CC-BY 3.0 licence on the source recording: the licence covers redistributing the audio clip, not synthesising new speech in that person voice and putting words in their mouth. A card exists only so nobody rediscovers the file and casts it by accident. Do not set this to ready. Source: BBC Radio 4 Desert Island Discs, 29 Jan 2012, via Wikimedia Commons. Note that voices_examples/#character_alias_map.txt already wires the alias Narrator to this file - that alias should not be used.
